WITH f AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(quantity) all_q, sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 0 else quantity end) nostaff_q, sum(net_amount) all_net, sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 0 else net_amount end) nostaff_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sum(f.all_q) fq, sum(f.nostaff_q) fq_ns, sum(r.units_sold) rpt_units, sum(f.all_net) fnet, sum(f.nostaff_net) fnet_ns, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(r.net_sales) rpt_net
FROM f JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=f.d AND r.store_id=108

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory AS product_group, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY ALL
